hypothesis: Proto's full-range action has already been decoded as an absolute joint target, so MapProtoPolicyTargetToMannyConstraintRange is a causal distortion. Bypassing only that remap while retaining AdaptParentRelativeTarget safety projection should improve locked standing behavior.
competing_explanations: The remap is required to translate Proto's full plus-or-minus-pi actuator range into Manny's authored joint ranges; bypassing it will drive more targets into safety projection and worsen behavior.

single_changed_variable.name: active_standing_constraint_range_remap
single_changed_variable.scope: WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS and RealOnnxPolicy and BalanceActive_Standing only

expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The experimental trace has zero constraint-range remap delta while safety projection remains active and target readback remains 1.0; the locked failed-criteria set strictly shrinks without adding a new failure.
falsification_observation: The trace proves the remap was bypassed but the failed-criteria set is unchanged or worse, a new locked failure appears, or safety projection saturates the unremapped targets without reducing failures.
validity_requirement: The baseline and experimental variants must reach the active-standing-only intervention from the same first policy input under the same commit, model, seed, fixed timestep, initial pose, and no-perturbation configuration.

primary_metrics: maximum root and body linear and angular speeds

implementation.commit_subject: Add test-only constraint range remap bypass

conclusion.summary: The development-only override correctly removed the constraint-range remap while preserving the existing safety projection and 21-of-21 target readback. Projection then increased from a maximum of 8.856 degrees to 67.033 degrees and the locked failure count increased from three to six. That adverse direction is mechanistically consistent with the competing explanation that Manny range mapping is required. However, the first policy-input snapshot already differed before the active-standing-only branch could execute, violating the pre-intervention equivalence requirement. The pair therefore cannot support or falsify the causal hypothesis.
